warning.description: A ghostly Graveclaw looms over his sealed crypt as champions prepare for his arrival.

spawn.description: Graveclaw stands above his open crypt with his claws raised, ready to fight.

defeat.description: The defeated Graveclaw lies fallen beside a glowing Dark Coin loot marker in the arena.

victory.description: Seen from behind, Graveclaw descends into his open crypt after defeating the champions.
